name: InternScience/Sage-A1.5 config.json
notes: Fetched 2026-10-22. config.json (raw/main) for InternScience/Sage-A1.5. model_type qwen3_5_moe with a vision_config (depth 27, hidden 1152, patch 16, spatial merge 2, out_hidden 2048) and text_config: 40 layers, hidden 2048, 16 attention heads with head_dim 256, 2 kv heads, num_experts 256 with num_experts_per_tok 8, moe_intermediate_size 512, shared_expert_intermediate_size 512, vocab 248320, max_position_embeddings 262144, mamba_ssm_dtype float32, full_attention_interval 4 and an explicit layer_types list putting 10 full_attention layers at indices 3, 7, 11, ..., 39 with the other 30 linear_attention. mtp_num_hidden_layers 1. The text_config matches Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's config on every field checked (layers, experts, routing, head geometry), which is the basis for calling this a post-train rather than a new architecture. KV per token = the 10 full layers x 2 kv heads x 256 x 2 x 2 bytes = 20,480 B; the 30 linear layers hold a constant-size state.
